name: mr_signpost
text: Wrenfield. Millhaven beyond. Valemere by the west road.
lines: Wrenfield. Millhaven beyond. Valemere by the west road.

name: mr_crown_notice
text: By order of the Reeve at Wrenfield: those who aid the rebellion will hang. Public judgment at midday.
lines: By order of the Reeve at Wrenfield: those who aid the rebellion
will hang. Public judgment at midday.
note: Backup hook: reading it also sets flag_hook_taren (advance Q_BV_S1 -> Q_BV_S2 if still active).

name: from_overworld
note: Arrive here from the overworld entrance millhaven_road.

name: from_wrenfield
note: Arrive here walking back out of Wrenfield by the north checkpoint.

name: mr_enter
note: Kael's road line on first entry.

name: traveler
speaker: Traveler
note: Walking north (toward the overworld) on the first stretch. Hook: sets flag_hook_taren; complete Q_BV_S1 if active, start Q_BV_S2. Faces up; turns to the player when spoken to.

name: architect_stones
lines: Old stones half-sunk in the grass. Architect work, if Kael had to guess.
The carvings are too worn to read.

name: mr_crown_patrol
note: Optional scripted patrol on the road (two Crown soldiers: one firm, one unwilling). Can be walked around through the grass or fought (enc_crown_patrol). Human soldiers, not Ash-corrupted.

name: mr_patrol_escort
note: Second patrol soldier (the unwilling one). Part of mr_crown_patrol; remove with it.
